capabilities: rate note maturity on a 0-5 scale
initialize gamification ratings across the vault
award points and levels in a profile leaf
exclude tags and folders from rating
extras: The README requests donations via Ko-Fi and mixes explanation with promotional language. Rating is purely statistical (title length, note length, link counts) and does not assess content quality; Hub/MOC notes are acknowledged as poorly handled and on the roadmap.
motivation: The author wants to bridge the time until a PKM pays off by generating fun and excitement that keeps motivation high, aiming to foster personal knowledge and better thinking.
problem: Personal knowledge management takes a long time to pay off, and motivation drops during that period.

relations.evidence: dataview for the number of notes in specified note maturity (0-5)

summary: Gamification plugin that rates note maturity (title, length, inlinks, outlinks), awards points and levels, and adds boosters to motivate PKM work.
